en.s: The Battle of al-Harra (Arabic: يوم الحرة, romanized: Yawm al-Ḥarra, lit. 'Day of al-Harra') was fought between the Umayyad army of the caliph Yazid I (r. 680–683) led by Muslim ibn Uqba and the defenders of Medina from the Ansar and Muhajirun factions, who had rebelled against the caliph. The battle took place at the lava field of Harrat Waqim in the northeastern outskirts of Medina on 26 August 683 and lasted less than a day.

zh.s: 683年8月26日，倭马亚哈里发叶齐德一世（在位680—683年）的军队与麦地那守军在麦地那东北郊的瓦基姆熔岩原交战。穆斯林·伊本·欧格巴率领倭马亚军队；麦地那守军来自反叛哈里发的辅士派和迁士派。战斗持续不到一天。

en.s: The Battle of Manzikert or Malazgirt was fought between the Byzantine Empire and the Seljuk Empire on 26 August 1071 near Manzikert, Iberia (modern Malazgirt in Muş Province, eastern Turkey). The decisive defeat of the Byzantine army and the capture of the emperor Romanos IV Diogenes played an important role in undermining Byzantine authority in Anatolia and Armenia, and allowed for the gradual Turkification of Anatolia.

zh.s: 曼齐刻尔特战役也称马拉兹吉尔特战役，于1071年8月26日在拜占庭帝国与塞尔柱帝国之间爆发，战场位于曼齐刻尔特附近的伊比利亚地区（今土耳其东部穆什省马拉兹吉尔特）。拜占庭军队遭到决定性失败，皇帝罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼被俘。这场战役削弱了拜占庭帝国对安纳托利亚和亚美尼亚的控制，并推动安纳托利亚逐渐突厥化。

en.s: The Battle of Kinugasa Castle (衣笠城合戦, Kinugasa Jō Kassen) was a battle between the Taira (and its 2 branches, the Edo and Chichibushi clans) against the pro-Minamoto Miura clan that took place on August 26, 1180 (Jishō calendar) (September 17, 1180 Julian calendar) at Kinugasa Castle in Sagami Province, which is now Kinugasa Town, Yokosuka City, Kanagawa Prefecture.

zh.s: 衣笠城之战（衣笠城合戦，Kinugasa Jō Kassen）于1180年8月26日（治承历；儒略历1180年9月17日）在相模国衣笠城发生。平氏及其两个分支江户氏和秩父氏，与支持源氏的三浦氏交战。衣笠城现位于神奈川县横须贺市衣笠町。

en.s: The Battle on the Marchfeld (i.e. Morava Field; Czech: Bitva na Moravském poli; Hungarian: Morvamezei csata) at Dürnkrut and Jedenspeigen took place on 26 August 1278 and was a decisive event for the history of Central Europe for the following centuries. The opponents were a Bohemian (Czech) army led by the Přemyslid king Ottokar II of Bohemia and the German army under the German king Rudolph I of Habsburg in alliance with King Ladislaus IV of Hungary. Although both sides had in their units also infantry, the battle itself was primarily a great collision of heavy knights cavalry, though the Cuman horse archers in the Hungarian army played a vital role.

zh.s: 1278年8月26日，马奇费尔德（即摩拉瓦平原）战役在迪恩克鲁特和耶登施派根一带爆发，对此后数百年的中欧历史产生了重大影响。交战双方是波希米亚普热米斯尔王朝国王奥托卡二世率领的波希米亚（捷克）军队，以及与匈牙利国王拉斯洛四世结盟、由德意志国王鲁道夫一世·哈布斯堡率领的德意志军队。双方都编有步兵，但战斗主要是重装骑士之间的大规模冲锋；匈牙利军中的库曼骑射手也发挥了关键作用。

en.s: In 1303, the Delhi Sultanate ruler Alauddin Khalji captured the Chittor Fort from the Guhila king Ratnasimha, after an eight month long siege. The conflict has been described in several legendary accounts, including the historic epic poem Padmavat, which claims that Alauddin's motive was to obtain king Ratnasimha's beautiful wife Padmavati.

zh.s: 1303年，德里苏丹国统治者阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉围攻奇陶尔堡八个月后，从古希拉王拉特纳辛哈手中攻下该堡。这场冲突见于多种传说记载，包括历史史诗《帕德玛瓦特》；该诗称，阿拉乌丁的动机是得到拉特纳辛哈美丽的妻子帕德玛瓦蒂。

en.s: The Battle of Crécy (1346), also called Battle of Cressy, was an English victory during the Edwardian phase of the Hundred Years' War. Coupled with the later battles of Poitiers (also fought during the Edwardian phase) and Agincourt, it was the first of the three major English successes during the conflict. The battle was fought on 26 August 1346 near Crécy, in northern France. An army of English, Welsh, and allied troops from the Holy Roman Empire led by Edward III of England, engaged and defeated a much larger army of French, Genoese and Majorcan troops led by Philip VI of France.

zh.s: 克雷西战役（1346年），又称克雷西战役，是英格兰在百年战争爱德华战争阶段取得的一场胜利。它与后来同属这一阶段的普瓦捷战役和阿金库尔战役并列，是英格兰在这场战争中的三次重大胜利。1346年8月26日，英格兰国王爱德华三世率领英格兰、威尔士及神圣罗马帝国盟军，在法国北部克雷西附近与法国国王腓力六世率领、规模大得多的法国、热那亚和马略卡军队交战并将其击败。

en.s: The siege of Moscow in 1382 was a battle between the Principality of Moscow and Tokhtamysh, khan of the Golden Horde. In August 1382, Tokhtamysh led a large army toward Moscow. At that time, Prince Dmitry Donskoy was not in the city as he was seeking assistance from other Russian territories. As a result, Moscow's defense was left in the hands of the people and a small garrison.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1382年，莫斯科公国与金帐汗国汗王脱脱迷失交战。1382年8月，脱脱迷失率大军向莫斯科进军。当时，德米特里·顿斯科伊大公不在城内，正在其他罗斯领地寻求援助，因此莫斯科的防守落在民众和一支小型驻军手中。

en.t: Battle of St. Jakob an der Birs
en.s: The Battle of St. Jakob an der Birs was fought between the Old Swiss Confederacy and French (mostly Armagnac) mercenaries, on the banks of the river Birs. The battle took place on 26 August 1444 and was part of the Old Zürich War.The site of the battle was near Münchenstein, Switzerland, just above 1 km outside the city walls of Basel, today within Basel's St-Alban district.

zh.t: 比尔斯河畔圣雅各布战役
zh.s: 1444年8月26日，旧瑞士邦联与法国雇佣兵（多数为阿马尼亚克派）在比尔斯河畔交战。这场战役属于旧苏黎世战争的一部分。战场位于瑞士明兴施泰因附近，距巴塞尔城墙外约1公里多，如今属于巴塞尔的圣阿尔班区。

en.s: Battle of Kringen (Norwegian: Slaget ved Kringen) involved an ambush by Norwegian peasant militia of Scottish mercenary soldiers who were on their way to enlist in the Swedish army for the Kalmar War. The battle has since become a part of folklore in Norway, giving names to local places in the Ottadalen valley.

zh.s: 克林根战役（挪威语：Slaget ved Kringen）中，挪威农民民兵伏击了一群前往瑞典军队、准备参加卡尔马战争的苏格兰雇佣兵。这场战役后来成为挪威民间传说的一部分，奥塔达伦山谷的一些当地地名也由此而来。

en.s: The Battle of San Salvador (1642), also known as the Second Battle of San Salvador, was a military assault launched by the Dutch on a small fortified Spanish settlement and its aboriginal allies in northern Formosa in 1642. After six days, the battle ended in defeat for the Spanish. The Spanish defeat secured complete island control for the Dutch.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1642年，荷兰军队进攻福尔摩沙北部一处由西班牙人及其原住民盟友防守的小型设防聚落。这场战斗也称第二次圣萨尔瓦多战役。六天后，西班牙方面战败，荷兰人由此完全控制该岛。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Olasch (also Ólas, Ulaş, Olaschin) took place after a Habsburg Imperial army led by Saxon Elector General, Augustus II the Strong, laid siege to Turkish held Temesvár. On 26 August 1696, after learning that Sultan Mustafa II's relief army was crossing the Danube at Pancsova, Augustus gave up the siege and headed to meet the Ottoman army.

zh.s: 萨克森选帝侯兼将军奥古斯特二世（强者奥古斯特）率领哈布斯堡帝国军队围攻由土耳其人控制的泰梅什堡后，奥拉什战役随之发生。1696年8月26日，奥古斯特得知穆斯塔法二世苏丹的援军正在潘切沃渡过多瑙河，于是放弃围城，前去迎战奥斯曼军队。

en.s: The Battle of Bagru was a military engagement fought between multiple Indian kingdoms in 1748 near the town of Bagru, Jaipur, India. The battle was fought during a succession crisis following the death of Jai Singh II, which left Jaipur without effective leadership. In the battle, Madho Singh defeated ishwari Singh in a 6-day engagement with help of Marathas and Kingdom of Bundi.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1748年，印度斋浦尔附近的巴格鲁镇发生战斗，参战方为多个印度王国。斋·辛格二世去世后，斋浦尔陷入继承危机，缺乏有效领导，战役也在这一背景下爆发。马多·辛格在马拉塔人和邦迪王国的帮助下，经过6天交战击败伊什瓦里·辛格。

en.t: The first Lutheran denomination in North America, the Pennsylvania Ministerium, is founded in Philadelphia
en.s: The Pennsylvania Ministerium was the first Lutheran church body in North America. With the encouragement of Henry Melchior Muhlenberg (1711–1787), the Ministerium was founded at a Church Conference of Lutheran clergy on August 26, 1748. The group was known as the "German Evangelical Lutheran Ministerium of North America" until 1792, when it adopted the name "German Evangelical Lutheran Ministerium of Pennsylvania and Adjacent States".

zh.t: 北美首个路德宗教会团体宾夕法尼亚教区会议成立
zh.s: 宾夕法尼亚教区会议是北美首个路德宗教会团体。在亨利·梅尔基奥尔·穆伦伯格（1711—1787）的鼓励下，路德宗牧师于1748年8月26日召开教会会议并成立该团体。它最初名为“北美德意志福音路德宗教区会议”，1792年改名为“宾夕法尼亚及邻近州德意志福音路德宗教区会议”。

en.t: Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen
en.s: The Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen (French: Déclaration des droits de l'Homme et du citoyen de 1789), set by France's National Constituent Assembly in 1789, is a human and civil rights document from the French Revolution; the French title can be translated in the modern era as "Declaration of Human and Civil Rights".
en.n: The Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen is approved by the National Constituent Assembly of France.

zh.s: 《人权和公民权宣言》（法语：Déclaration des droits de l'Homme et du citoyen de 1789）由法国国民制宪议会于1789年起草，是法国大革命时期的一份人权与公民权利文件。如今，其法文标题也可译为《人权与公民权宣言》。
zh.n: 法国国民制宪议会批准《人权和公民权宣言》。

en.s: The Ferrol Expedition (also known as the Battle of Brión) was an unsuccessful British attempt to capture Ferrol, Spain, on 25 and 26 August 1800. Ferrol was a major Spanish Navy base with a shipyard for shipbuilding and a dry dock for repairs.

zh.s: 1800年8月25日至26日，英国试图攻占西班牙费罗尔，但未能成功。这次行动也称布里翁战役。费罗尔是西班牙海军的重要基地，设有造船厂和用于维修的干船坞。

en.t: The former viceroy Santiago de Liniers of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata is executed after the defeat of his counter-revolution
en.s: Santiago Antonio María de Liniers y Bremond, 1st Count of Buenos Aires, KOM, OM (July 25, 1753 – August 26, 1810) was a Spanish military officer and a viceroy of the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata. Although born Jacques de Liniers in France, he is more widely known by the Spanish form of his name.

zh.t: 拉普拉塔总督辖区前总督圣地亚哥·德·利尼尔在反革命行动失败后被处决
zh.s: 圣地亚哥·安东尼奥·玛丽亚·德·利尼尔-布雷蒙，布宜诺斯艾利斯第一代伯爵（1753年7月25日—1810年8月26日）是西班牙军官，曾任拉普拉塔总督辖区总督。他出生于法国，原名雅克·德·利尼尔，但更广为人知的是其西班牙语姓名。

en.s: The Battle of the Katzbach on 26 August 1813, was an engagement of the Napoleonic Wars between the forces of the First French Empire under Marshal MacDonald and a Russo-Prussian army of the Sixth Coalition under Prussian Marshal Graf (Count) von Blücher. It occurred during a heavy thunderstorm at the Katzbach river between Wahlstatt and Liegnitz in the Prussian province of Silesia.

zh.s: 1813年8月26日，拿破仑战争期间，麦克唐纳元帅率领的法兰西第一帝国军队与第六次反法同盟的俄普联军交战，俄普联军由普鲁士元帅布吕歇尔伯爵指挥。战斗在一场强雷暴中于普鲁士西里西亚省的卡茨巴赫河畔、瓦尔施塔特和利格尼茨之间发生。

en.s: The Second Battle of St. Michaels was a raid conducted on Maryland's Eastern Shore by British soldiers during the War of 1812. The raid occurred on August 26, 1813, at points between Tilghman Island and the town of St. Michaels, Maryland. Local militia defended against the raiders. The Maryland Eastern Shore communities had access to the Chesapeake Bay, which was the main shipping route to important American cities such as Baltimore and Washington, D.C.

zh.t: 第二次圣迈克尔斯战役
zh.s: 1812年战争期间，英军在马里兰州东岸发动袭击。1813年8月26日，袭击发生在蒂尔格曼岛与马里兰州圣迈克尔斯镇之间的多个地点，当地民兵进行了抵抗。马里兰东岸社区可通往切萨皮克湾，该海湾是通往巴尔的摩和华盛顿特区等美国重要城市的主要航道。

en.s: The Battle of Les Tres Acequias, fought during the Chilean War of Independence, occurred near San Bernardo on 26 August 1814. The confrontation occurred between the two factions of Carrera and Bernardo O'Higgins, resulting in a defeat for O'Higgins that would in turn lead on to the defeat of the nationalists by the royalist forces at the battle of Rancagua a month later.

zh.t: 拉斯特雷斯阿塞基亚斯战役
zh.s: 智利独立战争期间，1814年8月26日，卡雷拉派与贝尔纳多·奥希金斯派在圣贝尔纳多附近交战。奥希金斯一方战败；一个月后，保王军又在兰卡瓜战役中击败民族主义者。

en.s: The 1833 Nepal–India earthquake occurred on August 26 at 22:58 local time (NPT). This earthquake had an estimated moment magnitude (Mw) of 7.6–7.9 and struck with an epicenter somewhere in or near the Kathmandu Valley. The earthquake caused major destruction in numerous towns and villages in Nepal, Northern India, and Tibet. The earthquake was also felt in Chittagong, Bangladesh.
en.n: This entry records the local date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1833年8月26日当地时间22时58分（尼泊尔标准时间），尼泊尔—印度地区发生地震，估计矩震级为7.6至7.9级，震中位于加德满都谷地内或附近。地震严重破坏了尼泊尔、印度北部和西藏的多个城镇与村庄，孟加拉国吉大港也有震感。

en.s: Battle of Grahovo was fought on 26 August 1836 between the Ottoman Empire and Montenegro, and was a prequel to the more famous Battle of Grahovac (1858). The battle ended in Ottoman victory, and was most notable for the death of nine members of the ruling House of Petrović-Njegoš, including Joko Petrović-Njegoš, brother of the prince-bishop Petar II and Stevan Petrović-Njegoš, brother of Grand Duke Mirko.

zh.s: 1836年8月26日，奥斯曼帝国与黑山交战。这场战役是更著名的1858年格拉霍瓦茨战役的前奏，最终以奥斯曼胜利告终。佩特罗维奇-涅戈什王室有9名成员在战斗中死亡，其中包括主教兼亲王彼得二世的兄弟约科·佩特罗维奇-涅戈什，以及米尔科大公的兄弟斯特万·佩特罗维奇-涅戈什。

en.s: The Battle of Galveston Harbor, or the Battle of Galveston Bay was a naval engagement between the Republic of Texas and Mexico in Galveston Harbor on August 26, 1837. After the end of the Texas Revolution in 1836, Mexico and the newly declared Republic of Texas sporadically fought at sea. Texas was hoping to gain independence, while Mexico was hoping to reassert control over Texas.

zh.s: 1837年8月26日，得克萨斯共和国与墨西哥在加尔维斯顿港交战。这场海战也称加尔维斯顿湾海战。1836年得克萨斯革命结束后，墨西哥与新宣布成立的得克萨斯共和国不时在海上交战。得克萨斯方面希望争取独立，墨西哥则希望重新控制得克萨斯。

en.s: The Battle of Amoy was fought between British and Chinese forces in Amoy (Xiamen), Fujian province, China, on 26 August 1841 during the First Opium War. The British captured the forts in Amoy and Gulangyu Island.

zh.s: 第一次鸦片战争期间，1841年8月26日，英军与清军在中国福建厦门交战。英军攻占了厦门的炮台和鼓浪屿。

en.t: President Faustin Soulouque of the First Republic of Haiti has the Senate and Chamber of Deputies proclaim him the Emperor of Haiti, abolishing the Republic and inaugurating the Second Empire of Haiti
en.s: Faustin-Élie Soulouque (French pronunciation: [fostɛ̃ eli suluk]; 15 August 1782 – 3 August 1867) was a Haitian politician and military officer who served as President of Haiti from 1847 to 1849 and Emperor of Haiti from 1849 to 1859. Soulouque was a general in the Haitian Army when he was appointed President of Haiti.

zh.t: 海地第一共和国总统福斯坦·苏卢克令参议院和众议院宣布他为海地皇帝，废除共和国并建立海地第二帝国
zh.s: 福斯坦-埃利·苏卢克（法语发音：[fostɛ̃ eli suluk]；1782年8月15日—1867年8月3日）是海地政治家和军官，曾于1847年至1849年担任海地总统，并于1849年至1859年担任海地皇帝。他获任海地总统时是海地军队的一名将军。

en.s: The Battle of Kessler's Cross Lanes, also known as the Battle of Cross Lanes, took place on August 26, 1861 in Nicholas County, Virginia (now West Virginia) as part of the Operations in Western Virginia Campaign during the American Civil War. On August 26, Brig. Gen. John B. Floyd, commanding Confederate forces in the Kanawha Valley, crossed the Gauley River to attack Col. Erastus Tyler's 7th Ohio Regiment encamped at Kessler's Cross Lanes. The Union forces were surprised and routed. Floyd then withdrew to the river and took up a defensive position at Carnifex Ferry. During the month, Gen.

en.s: The Battle of Sędziejowice, one of many clashes of the January Uprising, took place on 26 August 1863 near the village of Sędziejowice, which at that time belonged to Russian-controlled Congress Poland. A party of 1,500 Polish insurgents, commanded by Edmund Taczanowski, clashed with soldiers of the Imperial Russian Army, commanded by rittmeister von Grabbe. The battle resulted in Polish victory.

zh.s: 1863年8月26日，一月起义期间的多场战斗之一在森杰约维采村附近发生。当时该地属于俄国控制的波兰会议王国。埃德蒙·塔查诺夫斯基率领的1500名波兰起义军与俄国帝国军队交战，俄军由里特迈斯特冯·格拉贝指挥。战斗以波兰方面获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Yacaré was a battle fought in August 26, 1868, by Brazilian and Paraguayan forces during the Paraguayan War, part of the beginning of the Pikysyry campaign. It was a Brazilian victory. The allied army had only weeks before concluded operations around the Fortress of Humaitá and begun to advance north towards Asunción, the Paraguayan capital.

zh.s: 1868年8月26日，巴拉圭战争期间，巴西与巴拉圭军队在皮基西里战役初期交战，巴西获胜。几周前，盟军刚结束在乌迈塔要塞周边的行动，并开始向北推进，目标是巴拉圭首都亚松森。

en.s: The Little War or Small War (Spanish: Guerra Chiquita) was the second of three conflicts between Cuban rebels and Spain. It started on 26 August 1879 and after some minor successes ended in rebel defeat in September 1880. It followed the Ten Years' War of 1868–78 and preceded the final war of 1895–98, which resulted in American intervention and Cuban independence.

zh.s: 小战争（西班牙语：Guerra Chiquita）是古巴起义军与西班牙之间三场冲突中的第二场，1879年8月26日爆发。起义军取得一些小胜后，最终于1880年9月战败。此前发生过1868年至1878年的十年战争，此后是1895年至1898年的最后一场战争，最终导致美国介入和古巴独立。

en.t: A massive eruption (pictured) destroyed the island of Krakatoa, Indonesia, ejecting so much volcanic ash that average global temperatures fell by as much as 1.2 °C (2.2 °F) over the next year
en.s: Between 19 May and 21 October 1883, the volcanic island of Krakatoa (located in the Sunda Strait, then part of the Dutch East Indies—modern-day Indonesia) began erupting, lasting more than five months. On 27 August, the island had its most significant eruption, which destroyed over 70% of the island and its surrounding archipelago, the island collapsing into a caldera.

zh.s: 1883年5月19日至10月21日，位于巽他海峡的火山岛喀拉喀托开始喷发，当时该地属于荷属东印度（今印度尼西亚）。喷发持续了5个多月。8月27日火山发生最猛烈的喷发，摧毁了岛屿及周边群岛70%以上的面积，火山岛随后坍塌，形成火山口。

en.s: The Battle of Fuzhou, or Battle of Foochow, also known as the Battle of the Pagoda Anchorage (French: Combat naval de Fou-Tchéou, Chinese: 馬江海戰, 馬江之役 or 馬尾海戰, literally Battle of Mawei), was the opening engagement of the 16-month Sino-French War (December 1883 – April 1885). en.s: The Battle of Le Cateau was fought on the Western Front during the First World War on 26 August 1914. The British Expeditionary Force (BEF) and the French Fifth Army had retreated after their defeats at the Battle of Charleroi (21–23 August) and the Battle of Mons (23 August). The British II Corps fought a delaying action at Le Cateau to slow the German pursuit.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，1914年8月26日，西线爆发勒卡托战役。英国远征军和法国第五集团军在沙勒罗瓦战役（8月21日至23日）和蒙斯战役（8月23日）战败后撤退。英国第2军在勒卡托实施迟滞作战，以减缓德军追击。

en.s: The Battle of Río de Oro was a single-ship action fought in August 1914 during the First World War, when HMS Highflyer attacked the German SS Kaiser Wilhelm der Grosse off Río de Oro on the coast of Northwest Africa.

zh.s: 奥罗河海战是第一次世界大战期间发生于1914年8月的一次单舰交战。英国皇家海军“高飞”号在西北非洲海岸奥罗河附近袭击了德国邮轮“德皇威廉大帝”号。

en.s: The siege of Mora or siege of Moraberg, between Allied and besieged German troops, took place from August 1914 to February 1916 on and around the Mora mountain in northern Kamerun during the Kamerun campaign of the First World War. en.s: The Togoland campaign (6–26 August 1914) was a French and British invasion of the German colony of Togoland in West Africa, which began the West African campaign of the First World War. German colonial forces withdrew from the capital Lomé and the coastal province to fight delaying actions on the route north to Kamina, where the Kamina Funkstation (wireless transmitter) linked the government in Berlin to Togoland, the Atlantic and South America.

en.t: Spanish Civil War: Santander falls to the Nationalists and the Republican Interprovincial Council is dissolved
en.s: The Spanish Civil War (Spanish: guerra civil española) was fought in Spain from 1936 to 1939 between the Republicans and the Nationalist rebels. Republicans loyal to the left-leaning Popular Front government of the Second Spanish Republic included socialists, anarchists, communists, and separatists, supported by the Soviet Union. The opposing Nationalists were an alliance of Falangists, monarchists, conservatives, traditionalists, syndicalists and fascists, supported by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy.

zh.s: 西班牙内战（西班牙语：guerra civil española）于1936年至1939年在西班牙发生，交战双方是共和派和国民军叛军。效忠左翼第二西班牙共和国人民阵线政府的共和派包括社会主义者、无政府主义者、共产主义者和分离主义者，并得到苏联支持。国民军则由长枪党人、君主主义者、保守派、传统主义者、工团主义者和法西斯主义者结成联盟，得到纳粹德国和法西斯意大利支持。

The group's strategic significance stemmed from its location in the Mont Ventoux massif within the Rhône Valley, a region that offered natural protection and proximity to key transport routes.

en.s: The South African Border War, also known as the Angolan Bush War, was a largely asymmetric conflict that occurred in Namibia (then South-West Africa), Zambia, and Angola from 26 August 1966 to 21 March 1990. It was fought between the South African Defence Force (SADF) and the People's Liberation Army of Namibia (PLAN), an armed wing of the South West African People's Organisation (SWAPO). The South African Border War resulted in some of the largest battles on the African continent since World War II and was closely intertwined with the Angolan Civil War.

zh.s: 南非边境战争（又称安哥拉丛林战争）是一场不对称冲突，1966年8月26日至1990年3月21日间发生在纳米比亚（当时称西南非洲）、赞比亚和安哥拉。交战双方是南非国防军（SADF）与纳米比亚人民解放军（PLAN）；后者是西南非洲人民组织（SWAPO）的武装力量。这场战争引发了第二次世界大战后非洲大陆上一些规模最大的战斗，并与安哥拉内战密切交织。

en.s: The Battle of Ongulumbashe (also known as Operation Blouwildebees) was an armed confrontation between the South African Defence Force (SADF)/South African Police (SAP) and the South West African People's Organization (SWAPO) at Ongulumbashe in northern South West Africa (today Namibia). Though SWAPO had already carried out several attacks in 1965 and early 1966, the battle marked the first time that elements of the South African security forces directly clashed with SWAPO insurgents and is considered to be the start of the South African Border War.

zh.s: 翁古伦巴什战役（又称蓝角马行动）是南非国防军（SADF）和南非警察（SAP）与西南非洲人民组织（SWAPO）在西南非洲北部翁古伦巴什发生的武装冲突，该地现属纳米比亚。尽管SWAPO此前已于1965年和1966年初发动过数次袭击，这场战役仍是南非安全部队首次与SWAPO武装人员直接交火，并被视为南非边境战争的开端。

en.s: The Harvey's Resort Hotel bombing took place on August 26–27, 1980, when three men planted a bomb containing 1,000 pounds (450 kg) of dynamite at Harvey's Resort Hotel (now "Harveys") in Stateline, Nevada, United States. The mastermind behind the bomb, millionaire John Birges, was attempting to extort $3 million from the casino, claiming he had lost $750,000 gambling there. The FBI went to the spot they believed to be the ransom drop, but due to vague directions, Birges was waiting at a different location. No money was ever paid to Birges. The bomb was cleverly built and virtually tamper-proof.

zh.s: 1980年8月26日至27日，三名男子在美国内华达州斯泰特莱恩的哈维度假酒店（现名Harveys）安放了一枚装有1000磅（450千克）炸药的炸弹。幕后策划者、百万富翁约翰·比尔杰斯企图向赌场勒索300万美元，声称自己曾在那里赌博输掉75万美元。联邦调查局前往他们认为是交赎金的地点，但由于指示含糊，比尔杰斯当时等在另一处。比尔杰斯最终没有收到钱。炸弹制作精巧，几乎无法拆除。

en.t: The Jay Report into the Rotherham child sexual exploitation scandal is published
en.s: From the late 1980s until 2013, group-based child sexual exploitation affected an estimated 1,400 girls, generally from care home backgrounds, in the town of Rotherham, South Yorkshire, England. Between 1997 and 2013, girls were abused by grooming gangs predominantly consisting of men of Pakistani heritage. Researcher Angie Heal, who was hired by local officials and warned them about child exploitation occurring between 2002 and 2007, has since described it as the "biggest child protection scandal in UK history".
